name: ci-workflows
//: The GitHub Actions workflows and the CI-only script beside them (scripts/ci-gate.sh: tier routing and the release's sweep verdict), with their drift gates. Its own project so a workflow edit selects only what reads workflows, not the root crate's dependents. It depends on repo-tooling for the workflow lint script and on llmlint for the repo-root files its tests read (AGENTS.md, screencomp.toml).

lint-workflows.//: actionlint (the justfile's actionlint-version pin) over every workflow; `just lint-workflows` runs it.

options.command: bash tools/coverage/shcov.sh run ci-workflows -- cargo nextest run -p llmlint-ci-workflows --locked

test.//: The workflow drift gates and the CI routing and release-verdict journeys (.github/scripts/ci-gate.sh driven with synthetic events and a stand-in gh). Cached: its inputs are every file they read or run.
